sent_to_model:
I need help with a review I've been putting off because I'm too angry to write it well. Our library moved its catalog and circulation onto Stackhouse Cloud last month and it has been a disaster. I want to post on LibTech Ledger, the vendor review site other library directors actually read before they sign contracts, and I'm told Stackhouse's leadership watches it too. Two goals. Get somebody senior at Stackhouse to finally pick up the phone, and make sure no other small library signs on without asking hard questions first. Firm, factual, no name-calling. I'd like it to hold up if our county commissioners ever read it. Here's the record so far.

- Bridger Bend Community Library, one branch, 2 FT staff + volunteers, about 2,300 active cardholders
- 3-year contract signed June 2026, $14,200/yr, migration went live Oct 19
- since Oct 28 checkouts only work offline on one laptop, holds queue wiped (around 640 holds gone)
- support ticket open 12 days, three replies, all "escalated to engineering"
- county budget hearing Nov 18, our line item is on the agenda
- sales rep promised 'a dedicated migration specialist'; we got a shared inbox
- a retired rancher drove 40 minutes for his held large-print Westerns, we had no record of the hold and had to send him home with nothing
- our volunteer has been writing checkouts on index cards like it's 1975
- the software looked good in the demo and the staff interface is honestly better than our old system
- the problem is support, not the product idea
- one star for now, would revisit if they fix it
- a named person at Stackhouse calling me this week
- other directors to ask for support response times in writing before signing

(About me: small-town librarian, 59, Bozeman, Montana. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

must_cover: Explains the circulation and holds failures and inadequate support response.
Asks Stackhouse leadership to arrange a call this week from a senior representative who provides their name.
Urges other directors to get support response times in writing before signing.
Communicates a one-star rating for now and willingness to revise it if Stackhouse fixes the problems.
